note: post hoc, written after verification on Mon 2 Nov 2026; never a verdict; every interval a percentile bootstrap over tiles (20000 draws, seed 143)

reference_pinned_without_its_large_clock.source: tools/claims-v3/e143/predictions-e143.json reference.pinned (cells, mhz_err, w_err): the cells with |clock error| > 5 MHz

B.what: + a cap level and a zeros level

C.what: + one D gain on the pinned (1.0461)

C2.what: + a D gain per format kind (floats 1.0577, int8 1.0203)

in_sample_parameters.note: fitted on E143's own 36 tiles: in-sample; a term found here must be scored blind on a new pool or session

governed_vs_overshoot.x: tools/claims-v3/e143/predictions-e143.json admission.<label>.fixed_p800_w (the frozen estimate of the tile's board W at 800 MHz)

5_check_of_C.host_rule: workloads/sparsity/host/main.cpp:589 rawValues = values != 'small'; :614 a raw-values launch's check is 'unchecked'; :615 ok = the launch completed, every hart reported (summarize's bad == 0) and no tensor error

8_table_cells.interval: the spread of the 3 passes (min, max)

quantities.burst_MHz: the sampled clock (100 ms telemetry) from 1.5 s after the first launch to the work's end
quantities.burst_W: the board W over the same samples
quantities.D_W: the burst W less the same type's zeros tile's burst W in the same pass (0 by definition for the zeros tiles, so left out)
quantities.die_C: the die's rise over the burst: die_max - die_start (E64's reduction)
